new_facts_from_search: 2025-06: Penwood (Penwood Select Industrial Partners VII LP) / Saxum Real Estate JV bought the vacant 10-acre office site at 7 Campus Drive, Parsippany (reported ~$16.3M from The Birch Group, secondhand) to build a 128,150 SF spec warehouse (36' clear, 23 docks) due late 2026 - https://re-nj.com/saxum-penwood-eye-new-warehouse-project-in-parsippany-after-buying-vacant-office-building/

2025-12: Univest provided a $19.6M construction loan (arranged by Cushman & Wakefield) for the Parsippany JV - https://re-nj.com/cw-saxum-penwood-ink-19-6-million-construction-loan-for-parsippany-warehouse-project/ ; https://njbiz.com/parsippany-office-to-industrial-loan-7-campus-drive/

Penwood Select Industrial Partners VII closed 2023-09 at $425M (hard cap $500M); targets SoCal, NJ, NY, PA, Nevada; LPs include Connecticut Retirement ($100M), Virginia Retirement ($125M), SWIB ($100M + $35M co-invest); Fund VI closed 2021 at $325M - https://irei.com/news/penwood-announces-final-close-for-penwood-select-industrial-partners-vii-fund/ ; https://realassets.ipe.com/news/penwood-raises-425m-for-new-value-add-industrial-fund/10069386.article

Acquisitions leadership: Zack (Zachary) Flynn, Managing Director and Head of Acquisitions (also a firm owner, deal inquiries routed to him); Andrew MacDonald, Senior Vice President of Acquisitions covering East Coast; Ram Odedra, VP Acquisitions West Coast; owners Joseph Koziol, Christine Kubas, Zachary Flynn; Rick Chase retired 2023-12 - https://penwoodre.com/our-team/ ; https://penwoodre.com/

The unnamed 'Vice President of Acquisitions' quoted on Bordentown and Carlstadt is Andrew MacDonald - https://njbiz.com/penwood-real-estate-acquires-bordentown-industrial-property-for-60m/ ; https://www.marejournal.com/post/penwood-announces-the-acquisition-of-305-veterans-blvd-in-carlstadt-nj

Carlstadt (305 Veterans Blvd, 109,775 SF, 3.5 ac) and Moonachie (1 Caesar Place, ~97,000 SF, $31.25M) are two distinct Meadowlands buys, not one deal as the pack suspected; Carlstadt acquisition was Chaus-brokered and reported 2022-08, building vacant at purchase, financed 2023-02 - https://re-nj.com/penwood-adds-110000-sq-ft-meadowlands-industrial-property-in-chaus-brokered-deal/ ; https://re-nj.com/penwood-fund-buys-97000-sq-ft-meadowlands-industrial-building-for-31-million/ ; https://www.commercialsearch.com/news/penwood-lands-financing-for-new-jersey-industrial-asset/

Lawrenceville JV site is 10 Princess Road, 31 acres, former hospital site, planned 350,000 SF; article roughly 2019 (date approx.) - https://re-nj.com/developer-acquires-mercer-county-site-plans-350000-sq-ft-industrial-project/
No Penwood NJ sale or lease in 2024-2026 found in public sources; no change of stated strategy found (still value-add industrial in NY/NJ gateway + SoCal, now plus PA/Nevada via Partners VII)
